outcome: Time to human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) drop
cohort: 10 patients with diagnosed live cervical pregnancy (n=3) and cesarean scar pregnancy (n=7) between 6 and 8 weeks' gestation
finding: The double-balloon catheter was a successful, minimally invasive, and well-tolerated single treatment for cervical pregnancy and cesarean scar pregnancy in this small study.
